# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Record the test that the appliance failed that lead to the appliance being rendered unfit for use.
3. Mark the failed test as an alarm using the aptos crash icon.

Example - if you tested the flex and plug, ensured the metal body was earthed and then faulted the appliance an EICR, the test you should mark as a fault is the EICR since based on the passing flex, plug and earth integrity test, this is where your appliance broke down.

## Example 1) EICR fault on an electric kettle

This EICR typically occurs due to overheating a heating element and is caused due to the automatic dry boil protection failing or the heating elements are tilted which prevents the cup from being placed squarely.
